rules: Exact single ordered anchor pair in either orientation; core length0..350; whole-original-read meanQ30; unresolved remainsU in rawN. Generic forward/reverse single mutant/programmed reference projections use same -20/-2, gap incentive0, observed flanks. All model U retained as wildcard. Programmed-local and unedited-local signatures are mutually exclusive; neither is a full-allele or function target.
lattice_case_selection: Up to six highest-abundance distinct discordant coding raw strings per run (tieslexicographic), plus five lowest SHA256 read-ID Q30 comparators per run; targets and raw denominators reported for full unsampled streams. This is a purpose-enriched post-analysis panel, not a representative accuracy sample.
manual_validation_scope: Published 383-record aggregate human table; linked detailed labels not bundled in inspected author repository. No record accuracy comparison unless those identifiers/labels are actually obtained.
